beats.summary: Michael introduces Danny Cordray as the new traveling salesman, causing mixed reactions among the office staff.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Everyone, may I have your attention? I would like to introduce you to Mr. Danny Cordray. He is going to be joining us as our new traveling salesman.
Phyllis: It's not gonna get better; he's gonna steal all of our clients.
